# The sync guard cannot see a repository-qualified corpus path

Refs #17920

## Context

D#17846 §8.3a (ruled 2026-09-01 by @neo-opus-vega with @neo-opus-ada) moves the emitted corpus under a repository segment: active facets land at `resources/content/<repoSlug>/<family>/chunk-N/`, while `archive/` and `release-notes` keep their flat homes. Item 6 sizes the work as **two PRs in a fixed order — Engine first, Brain second** — precisely so the Engine guard is never quiet while the corpus moves. Item 5 names this change: `check-chore-sync.mjs` `generatedSyncPaths` gains the new active roots.

`#17920` carries the Brain half (producer emission dirs, `parseContentPath`, KB `sourcePaths`) and every one of its ACs is Brain-side. This is the Engine leaf, filed so the first PR closes something honest rather than closing `#17920` while half its scope is undelivered.

## The Problem

`buildScripts/util/check-chore-sync.mjs` recognises generated corpus content by flat prefix (`resources/content/issues/`, `.../pulls/`, `.../discussions/`, …). A path carrying a repository segment matches none of them.

`isGeneratedSyncFile` has two consumers, and an unrecognised shape breaks them in **opposite** directions:

| arm | state today | on an unrecognised shape |
|---|---|---|
| leakage (`:113`) — every ordinary commit, via `.husky/pre-commit` | **armed** | the filter goes **empty** and the check exits **0** — the guard stops guarding, silently |
| `NEO_SYNC_AUTOCOMMIT` (`:78`) — inverts the same predicate | **dormant** | rejects a sync-only staging as non-sync |

**The second row is bounded, and the bound belongs in this sentence rather than a footnote:** nothing sets `NEO_SYNC_AUTOCOMMIT` — searched `buildScripts/`, `.github/`, `.husky/` and `test/` in `neomjs/neo`, and `ai/` + `.github/` in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain` — and the Data Sync pipeline commits with `--no-verify` (`buildScripts/dataSyncPipeline.mjs:940`, `.github/workflows/data-sync-pipeline.yml:189`), so it never reaches this hook at all. That arm is worth keeping correct because a bypass that is wrong while unused is wrong the day something uses it — not because it fires today.

So the live failure is the first row, and it is the silent one. `.husky/pre-commit:1` is this guard's only invoker; it runs in no workflow, so nothing in CI would go red in its place.

## The Architectural Reality

- `buildScripts/util/check-chore-sync.mjs` — `generatedSyncPaths` (flat prefixes) feeding `isGeneratedSyncFile`; the merge-inheritance rule comes from the sibling `mergeInheritance.mjs`.
- `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/check-chore-sync.spec.mjs` — this guard's spec, itself restored under `#17922` (that ticket's table lists it at 224 lines, caller `.husky/pre-commit`).
- The emitted shape is fixed by the ruling: `repoSlug` is the KB's `defaultRepoSlug`, the bare repository name (`neo`), with the owner carried by `tenantId`. It is **one** path segment — `neo-agent-brain:ai/services/github-workflow/shared/contentPath.mjs` `parseContentPath` reads an active path as exactly 3 contentRoot-relative segments today, which is what makes the qualified active path 4 and the slug one segment.

## The Fix

Recognise both shapes. The qualified form is matched **structurally** — `resources` / `content` / *any* slug / a known family — rather than against a slug allowlist, so a second organisation repository is not another place to remember. The family segment is what makes a path generated content, which keeps hand-authored material under the same root (`resources/content/concepts/…`) out of the guard's reach.

Purely additive, and inert until something emits under the new root. That is exactly why it lands first.

## Decision Record impact

`none`. D#17846 §8.3a is a Discussion ruling, not an ADR, and no ADR is amended. ADR 0040 §2.3 stays satisfied — this change adds no Engine→Brain dependency (that ADR lives at `neo-agent-brain:learn/agentos/decisions/0040-agentos-extraction-topology.md`; it is not in this repository, and its absence here is the wrong tree, not counter-evidence).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A path under `resources/content/<slug>/<family>/` is rejected by the leakage arm on a feature branch — and the same path exits **0** against the pre-change guard, shown as a mutation in both directions.
- [ ] With `NEO_SYNC_AUTOCOMMIT=1` the real post-cut topology stages clean: `issues` / `discussions` / `pulls` qualified, `release-notes` and `archive/` flat, root index flat.
- [ ] A non-family segment under a slug (`resources/content/neo/concepts/…`) is still not corpus data — a control that passes against **both** guard versions, so the match cannot have quietly widened to the whole root.
- [ ] `release-notes` and `archive/` keep their flat prefixes; this PR moves no path.
- [ ] Post-merge only: when the Brain half of `#17920` emits under the new root, the first sync-authoring attempt on a feature branch is rejected rather than passing quietly.

## Out of Scope

- The Brain half — producer emission dirs, `parseContentPath`, KB `sourcePaths` — is `#17920`.
- Moving `release-notes` under a repository root (D#17846 §8.8, undecided) and dissolving `archive/` into the version segment (§8.3a item 1, its own ticket, unowned).
- Restoring coverage for the other `buildScripts` guards — `#17922`.
- Why `NEO_SYNC_AUTOCOMMIT` has no setter in either repository. Captured as a defect-note; it belongs to `#17920`'s pipeline restoration, not here.

## Avoided Traps

- **Matching `resources/content/<anything>/`.** It swallows hand-authored trees that merely share the root; the third AC is the control that keeps the match honest.
- **An allowlist of repository slugs.** A second organisation repository would then fail open until someone remembered to extend the list — the same silent-open class this ticket closes.
- **Replacing the flat prefixes instead of adding to them.** Both shapes are live simultaneously under the ruling; a transitional read breaks `archive/` and `release-notes`.
- **Landing after the producer.** The reverse order leaves a review-latency window in which the corpus has moved and the guard is quiet — item 6's stated reason for the ordering.
